**April 09, 2025**

Dr. Kimberly Joyce 
Proctor-Hendricks Medical Group

Today, I saw Daniel Rogers for his routine follow-up regarding his HIV infection. Mr. Rogers presented in good spirits and reports feeling well overall. His blood pressure was recorded at 142/92, and his weight was 158 pounds. On further examination, Daniel's physical condition appeared stable with no new concerning symptoms. 

Daniel has managing his HIV infection with ART for approximately 5.8 years now. His viral load has remained undetectable for the past 22 months, indicating excellent control of his HIV status. His CD4 count is currently 508 cells/mm³, which within the normal range and supports the sustained effectiveness of his treatment. 

Daniel continues to take dolutegravir 50 mg daily, a medication he has adhered to without any reported side effects. I reviewed his medication regimen and advised him to continue taking his ART as prescribed. We discussed the importance of regular follow-up appointments and lab tests to monitor HIV status.

**February 07, 2024**

On this visit, Daniel presented with a complaint of back strain, likely due to an overexertion incident. His blood pressure was 141/92, and his weight had decreased slightly to 147 pounds. His vital signs and physical exam findings were otherwise unremarkable. 

Daniel continues to manage his HIV infection effectively. He has been on ART for about 5.8 years, and his viral load has remained undetectable for the past 22 months. His CD4 count is 508 cells/mm³. Daniel is on dolutegravir 50 mg daily and reports no side effects from the medication. 

I discussed the back strain with Daniel, providing advice on rest, physical therapy if needed, and over-the-counter pain relief. I reassured him that his HIV remains well controlled with no clinical concerns.

**December 07, 2022**

Today, Daniel visited for his regular HIV follow-up. He is in good health and spirits, with a blood pressure of 136/87 and a weight of 156 pounds. His physical examination showed no abnormalities. 

Daniel has on ART for around 5.8 years, with his viral load undetectable for the past 22 months. His CD4 count is cells/mm³, indicating good immune function. He is continuing with dolutegravir 50 mg daily, and there have been no reported issues with his medication. 

I reviewed his ART regimen and emphasized the importance of adherence to maintain his HIV control. Daniel’s HIV status remains stable, with no new clinical issues.
